decisions.reason: With several overlapping express delivery options and only a minor website mention, the option has likely resolved as low-value and resources are better shifted to the broader express line.

This faster express option may retain some uncertainty, but as a close-to-established service with many substitutes and limited prominence, the option no longer justifies commitment given competing uses for resources.
The fire-resistant steel exterior door is prominently featured and has European approval, so its option value remains high and dropping it is unlikely.
As a dedicated express delivery line with multiple models and its own page, it appears to be a core service option whose uncertain demand still justifies the low carrying cost.
The online ordering and digital services platform supports the firm's strategic shift toward deeper advisory and service support, so the option remains valuable while uncertainty persists.
Fire and smoke protection doors are central to the firm's safety-certified offer and regulatory market, so this close-to-established option is worth keeping despite limited website prominence.
